Question 14
?

Find the Cartesian equation of the parabola defined by the parametric equations

x+5=−2t,y+2=−t2,t∈(−∞,∞).

a
(x+5)2=−2(y+2)
b
(x+5)2=−8(y+2)
c
(x+5)2=−4(y+2)
d
(x−5)2=4(y−2)
e
(x−5)2=8(y−2)
